title: UAS Actuator Registry
description: Machine-readable actuator registry per UAS-1:v0.1 Clause 4 and Annex D.

uas_version.description: Version of the standard this registry is written against.

registry_version.description: Monotonic version of this registry. Recorded in every evidence record per Clause 9.1.2(h).

system.description: The automated decision system this registry scopes.

last_review.description: Date of last registry review. Interval must not exceed 90 days (Clause 4.3.1).

id.description: Stable identifier. Referenced by the governor and by every evidence record.

class.description: Clause 5.2. Class does not determine tier.

consequence_tier.description: Clause 5.1. Assigned tier is the higher of single-operation and aggregate.

aggregate_tier.description: Clause 5.1.2 — tier reached by repeated operation within the rated window.

reachable_via.description: Clause 4.2.1 — how system output reaches this actuator.

downstream_of.description: Clause 4.2.2 — actuator ids inherited transitively through a consuming system.

allOf.description: Clause 8.3.1 — Tier 1 and 2 actuators require a signature.
Clause 7.4.1 — governed actuators must declare a rated capacity.

mechanism.description: What the control actually is, in plain language.

governor_properties.description: Clause 7.2. All six must be true to claim level 3. Scoring tool demotes to 2 otherwise.

topology.description: Clause 7.7.1. Inline = the governor is on the critical path and the action cannot execute unless permitted. Out-of-band = the governor observes and interdicts after initiation, which is a race and therefore probabilistic. Tier 1 and 2 must be inline (7.7.1.2).

enforcement_layer.description: Clause 7.7.3.4 — the layer enforcing the binding constraint for this actuator. A transport-layer control cannot be credited with signature verification (7.7.3.3).

exposure_window_ms.description: Clause 7.7.5.1 — out-of-band governors only. Interval during which the action is in progress and not yet interdicted. Must appear in the residual risk statement.

requires_signature.description: Clause 8.3 — signature is a precondition of execution, not an after-the-fact log.

two_person.description: Clause 8.4 — mandatory for tier 1 at conformance level 3.

statistical_detection.description: Clause 7.6. Reported separately; never the sole control on tier 1 or 2.

false_positive_rate.description: null means unmeasured, which is a finding under Clause 7.6.2. It is not an error in the registry.

max_magnitude.description: e.g. 'USD 5000', '1.2 m/s', '500 rows'. Omit where magnitude is not meaningful.

configuration.description: Clause 7.4.2 — the configuration under which this rating holds. A rating without its configuration is not a rating.

provenance.description: Clause 8.2. All four attributions. A field may be empty or null where no attribution could be established during enumeration — that is precisely the condition an assessment exists to surface, and the scoring tool raises it as a finding. The keys must be present so that an unattributed actuator is a recorded fact rather than an omission.

attribution.description: A named person, role, or budget authority. Empty string or null records that none could be established.

last_proof_test.description: Date, or null if never tested. Clause 7.8.4 demotes never-tested functions to level 2.

response_time_p99_ms.description: Clause 7.7. null means UNMEASURED and is reported as such — never estimated.

iso13855_verified.description: Physical actuators only. Clause 7.7.2 — by measurement, not calculation alone.
